sahneler.metin: In Massachusetts, gas fires and explosions hit dozens of homes at once.
Within hours, houses burned across three towns, and one person was killed.
Workers had taken an old gas main out of service.
But sensing lines for the pressure regulators were still attached to it.
So they opened fully and flooded the network with high pressure gas.
Appliances and pipes couldn't handle it.
Gas work plans now need engineering review of these lines.
